title: x-prepkit
description: Curation metadata kept beside each apm dependency of a preset. Keyed by the dependency without its #sha.

reviewed.description: Commit sha the curator read before listing the dependency. Must equal the #sha on the dependency line.

license.description: SPDX identifier of the upstream repo or skill folder.

conflicts.description: Advisory. Skill or preset names that overlap with this one; CI tests the combinations.

optional.description: Safe to leave out when a project lists this preset's dependencies by hand.

note.description: One line for the next curator: where the license was read, why the skill is here.
